def main():
    s = input().strip()
    print(s[0], end='')
    replaced_at = False

    def walk(i):
        nonlocal replaced_at
        l = len(s)
        if i >= l:
            return
        if s[i] == 'a' and not replaced_at and i + 1 < l and s[i + 1] == 't':
            print('@', end='')
            replaced_at = True
            walk(i + 2)
            return
        if s[i] == 'd' and i + 2 < l - 1 and s[i + 1] == 'o' and s[i + 2] == 't':
            print('.', end='')
            walk(i + 3)
            return
        print(s[i], end='')
        walk(i + 1)

    walk(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
